article.title_es: Masbia of Flatbush: despensa y comedor en Brooklyn
article.title_en: Masbia of Flatbush: food pantry and soup kitchen in Brooklyn
article.summary_es: Masbia of Flatbush es una despensa de alimentos y comedor de sopa en Brooklyn, en la avenida Coney Island. Atiende de lunes a jueves y los domingos, con horario por la tarde y noche.
article.summary_en: Masbia of Flatbush is a food pantry and soup kitchen in Brooklyn, on Coney Island Avenue. It is open Monday through Thursday and on Sundays, in the afternoon and evening.
how_they_help_es: Es una despensa de alimentos según el mapa Food Help NYC de la Ciudad.
También funciona como comedor de sopa (soup kitchen).
Está ubicado en 1372 Coney Island Ave, Brooklyn, NY 11230.
Abre de lunes a jueves y los domingos, de 12pm a 9pm.
La lista no indica qué alimentos entrega ni los requisitos; pregunte por teléfono.
how_they_help_en: Listed as a food pantry on the City's Food Help NYC map.
It also operates as a soup kitchen.
Located at 1372 Coney Island Ave, Brooklyn, NY 11230.
Open Monday through Thursday and Sundays, 12pm to 9pm.
The listing does not say what food is given or any requirements; ask by phone.
visit_tips_es: Horario de despensa: lunes a jueves y domingo, 12pm a 9pm.
Horario del comedor: lunes a jueves y domingo, 4pm a 9pm.
Antes de ir, llame al (718) 972-4446 para confirmar detalles.
visit_tips_en: Pantry hours: Monday to Thursday and Sunday, 12pm to 9pm.
Soup kitchen hours: Monday to Thursday and Sunday, 4pm to 9pm.
Before going, call (718) 972-4446 to confirm details.
